mapper.select: SELECT i.item_id as itemId, i.item_name as itemName, i.item_brand as itemBrand, i.item_price as itemPrice, i.item_stock as itemStock, i.item_category as dbCategory, i.item_type as dbType, i.reg_time as regTime, (SELECT item_url FROM item_img WHERE item_id = i.item_id LIMIT 1) as itemUrl FROM item i ORDER BY i.item_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item ( item_name, item_brand, item_price, item_stock, item_category, item_type, reg_time ) VALUES ( #{itemName}, #{itemBrand}, #{itemPrice}, #{itemStock}, #{dbCategory}, #{dbType}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE item SET item_name = #{itemName}, item_brand = #{itemBrand}, item_price = #{itemPrice}, item_stock = #{itemStock}, item_category = #{dbCategory}, item_type = #{dbType} WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item_img ( item_id, item_url, img_name, origin_name, is_main, reg_time ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, CONCAT('/user/posting/', #{fileName}), #{fileName}, #{fileName}, #{isMain}, NOW() )
